raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "03551bb4433442d98fbf2af30c17c07e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Plans for responding to AI system incidents."}, {"item_id": "03551bb4433442d98fbf2af30c17c07e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The plans are to be documented, practiced and measured, including response and down times."}, {"item_id": "b1aecfc472f340d9b7b446233077be52::claim_text", "attribute": "claim_text", "fact_text": "When risks arise, resources are allocated based on the assessed risk of a given AI system."}, {"item_id": "a9b52499e0764c6483f202dd3e2e1f5e::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The characteristics with which monitored risks and negative and positive impacts are associated."}, {"item_id": "b95d0a1bdcc2451da638c229fe5ed8b2::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Parties engaged regularly as part of AI system update activities."}, {"item_id": "b95d0a1bdcc2451da638c229fe5ed8b2::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "The parties include relevant AI actors."}, {"item_id": "0586f2e476cc4691b075434eac97604b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Processes and standards for mapping and measuring AI risk."}, {"item_id": "0586f2e476cc4691b075434eac97604b::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Policies should outline and document these processes and standards."}, {"item_id": "2e00f56c365e4ceeaf62a4a69d73f3c3::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Reconsider the design, implementation strategy, or deployment of AI systems with"}, {"item_id": "d6ffbe4576aa4f21ae6b24cb70aec9d1::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Benefits of intended AI system functionality and performance that are examined and documented."}, {"item_id": "398b5e4e08534726aa3082d2404faaf5::description", "attribute": "description", "fact_text": "Concern arising from dependence on large scale datasets."}]}
